'''Dakota Natural Gas Drayton Pipeline''' is a cancelled natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline was proposed to run from Viking Gas Transmission town border station northwest of Donaldson, Minnesota to Drayton, North Dakota.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2018/07/16/2018-15128.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Dakota Natural Gas LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2018/07/16/2018-15128.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''17.3 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2018/07/16/2018-15128.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''2, 4 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Cancelled<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$3,200,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
